discovered_fields.name: attest_services_types
discovered_fields.description: Enumerated types of attest services that constitute the regulated scope of practice, typically defined by reference to AICPA/PCAOB standards.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: (a) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (b) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (c) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (d) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB; and (e) Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE, other than an examination described in paragraph (c).

discovered_fields.name: compilation_services_authorized
discovered_fields.description: Whether compilation services (presenting financial statements as management's representation without assurance) are separately defined and regulated as a distinct service type.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presented in the form of financial statements information that is the representation of management (owners) without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

discovered_fields.name: education_semester_hours_required
discovered_fields.description: Total semester hours of college education required for initial CPA licensure (typically 150 hours post-2000).
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The education and experience requirements for an applicant are a baccalaureate degree or its equivalent conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board and additional semester hours or post-baccalaureate study so that the total educational program includes at least 150 hours.

discovered_fields.name: exam_sit_hours_minimum
discovered_fields.description: Minimum semester hours of college education required before a candidate may sit for the CPA examination (often 120 hours, less than the full 150 required for licensure).
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The board may permit a candidate to take the examination if the candidate has at least one hundred twenty semester hours of college education.

discovered_fields.name: ethics_exam_required
discovered_fields.description: Whether a separate ethics examination (e.g., AICPA ethics exam or state-specific ethics exam) is required as a condition of initial licensure.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The applicant has successfully passed the AICPA self-study course and examination in professional ethics.

discovered_fields.name: practice_privilege_no_notice_required
discovered_fields.description: Whether out-of-state CPAs with substantially equivalent qualifications may practice in the state without providing notice, paying a fee, or making any submission to the board.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an individual who offers or renders professional services, whether in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, under this section shall be granted practice privileges in this state and no notice, fee, or other submission shall be provided by any such individual.

discovered_fields.name: practice_privilege_consent_conditions
discovered_fields.description: Conditions to which an out-of-state CPA exercising practice privileges must consent, including board jurisdiction, compliance with state law, cessation if license lapses, and appointment of home-state board as agent for service of process.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Any individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the firm that employs that licensee hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: (1) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (2) To comply with this chapter and the board's rules; (3) That in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of a firm; and (4) To the appointment of the state board which issued the individual's license as the individual's or firm's agent for service of process.

discovered_fields.name: attest_services_require_firm_permit
discovered_fields.description: Whether individuals with practice privileges or individual licensees must perform certain attest services (audits, PCAOB engagements) only through a firm holding a valid permit.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs any financial statement audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards may only do so through a firm which has obtained a permit issued under this chapter.

discovered_fields.name: firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required
discovered_fields.description: Whether a simple majority (more than 50%) of firm ownership in terms of financial interests and voting rights must belong to licensed CPAs.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state.

discovered_fields.name: nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted
discovered_fields.description: Whether CPA firms may include owners who are not licensed CPAs, subject to specified conditions.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: For the purposes of issuing a permit under this section, a firm may include owners who are not certified public accountants if (1) the firm designates a certified public accountant or an individual with practice privileges to be responsible for the proper registration of the entity; (2) all of the owners of the firm who are not certified public accountants are active individual participants in the firm or in an entity affiliated with the firm.

discovered_fields.name: peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal
discovered_fields.description: Whether peer review is required as a condition for renewal of a firm permit or registration.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The board shall, not more frequently than once every three years, require as a condition for renewal of a permit of a firm that the applicant firm undergo a peer review conducted as required by the board by regulation.

discovered_fields.name: peer_review_max_frequency_years
discovered_fields.description: Maximum frequency (in years) at which peer review may be required for firm permit renewal.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The board shall, not more frequently than once every three years, require as a condition for renewal of a permit of a firm that the applicant firm undergo a peer review.

discovered_fields.name: peer_review_records_privileged
discovered_fields.description: Whether peer review proceedings, records, and work papers are privileged and not subject to discovery or introduction into evidence in civil or administrative proceedings.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The proceedings, records, and work papers of a review committee shall be privileged and shall not be subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process or introduction into evidence in any civil action, arbitration, administrative proceeding, or board proceeding.

discovered_fields.name: inactive_license_status_available
discovered_fields.description: Whether a licensee who is not engaged in the practice of public accounting may place their license on inactive status, typically with reduced fees and no CPE requirement.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Notwithstanding AS 08.04.105 or 08.04.195, an individual holding a license who is not engaged in the practice of public accounting may maintain the license in good standing by notifying the board that the individual is inactive and paying the required fee.

discovered_fields.name: retired_license_status_available
discovered_fields.description: Whether a licensee may place their license on a retired status, typically with reduced or no fees and no CPE requirement, with restrictions on active practice.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The board by regulation may allow persons to retire the certificate. A person classified as retired shall pay a fee to be established by board rule. A person classified as retired may assume or use the title or designation 'certified public accountant' or the abbreviation 'CPA' and shall use the words 'retired' adjacent to the designation.

discovered_fields.name: out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption
discovered_fields.description: Whether a firm without an office in the state may provide certain services (compilation, review, or non-attest services) without obtaining a firm permit, subject to specified conditions.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A firm that does not have an office in this state may perform services described in subdivision (B) or (E) of paragraph (2) of Code Section 43-3-2 for a client that specifies a location in this state to which any service is directed and may use the title 'CPA' or 'CPA firm' without being licensed as provided in this Code section only if it meets the qualifications described in paragraph (1) of subsection (a) of this Code section, complies with the board's rules or regulations regarding peer review, and performs such services through an individual with substantial equivalency practice privileges.

discovered_fields.name: office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_required
discovered_fields.description: Whether each office of a firm established in the state for the practice of public accounting must be under the direct supervision of a licensed CPA.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Each office established or maintained in this state for the practice of public accounting shall be under the direct supervision of an individual who holds a license issued under this chapter.

discovered_fields.name: attest_report_signer_competency_requirement
discovered_fields.description: Whether individuals who sign or authorize signing of attest or compilation reports on behalf of a firm must meet specific competency requirements set out in professional standards.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Any individual licensee who is responsible for supervising attest or compilation services and signs or authorizes an individual to sign the accountant's report on behalf of the firm shall meet the competency requirements set out in the professional standards adopted by the board for the services.

discovered_fields.name: client_confidentiality_privilege
discovered_fields.description: Whether communications between a licensee and client are confidential and privileged, with specified exceptions for professional standards, court proceedings, peer review, and ethical investigations.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A license holder, a permit holder, or a practice privilege holder or a partner, an officer, a shareholder, a member, or an employee of a license holder, a permit holder, or a practice privilege holder may not reveal information communicated to the license holder, permit holder or practice privilege holder by a client about a matter concerning which the client has employed the license holder, permit holder, or practice privilege holder in a professional capacity.

discovered_fields.name: working_papers_ownership_by_licensee
discovered_fields.description: Whether working papers, schedules, and memoranda made by a licensee incident to professional services remain the property of the licensee (absent contrary agreement), with restrictions on transfer without client consent.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or a public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to a client, except reports submitted to a client, are the property of the accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the accountant and the client to the contrary.

discovered_fields.name: commission_prohibition_during_attest
discovered_fields.description: Whether a licensee is prohibited from receiving commissions or referral fees when also performing attest or compilation services for the same client.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A licensee shall not for a commission recommend or refer to a client any product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer any product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee or the licensee's firm also performs for that client: (i) An attest service; or (ii) A compilation when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the compilation and the compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence.

discovered_fields.name: contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest
discovered_fields.description: Whether a licensee is prohibited from performing services for a contingent fee when also performing attest or compilation services for the same client, or from preparing tax returns for a contingent fee.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A licensee shall not perform for a contingent fee any professional services for, or receive such a fee from, a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (i) An attest service; or (ii) A compilation, when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the compilation and the compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence. A licensee shall not prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for any client.

discovered_fields.name: safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonlicensees
discovered_fields.description: Whether the statute provides specific safe harbor disclaimer language that nonlicensees may use when preparing financial statements without expressing assurance, thereby avoiding unlicensed practice violations.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing in the form of financial statements information that is the representation of management (owners). I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

discovered_fields.name: foreign_accountant_practice_exception
discovered_fields.description: Whether holders of foreign country accounting designations may practice in the state under limited conditions (serving only clients from their home country, using only their foreign title, not issuing reports on domestic entities).
discovered_fields.sample_quote: This chapter does not apply to an individual or a firm that holds a designation granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of accountancy or its equivalent in that country, whose activities in Indiana are limited to the provision of professional services to individuals or firms who are residents, to governments, or to business entities of the country in which the individual holds the entitlement, that does not issue reports with respect to the financial statements of another individual, firm, or governmental unit in Indiana, and that does not use in Indiana any title or designation other than the title or designation under which the individual practices in the individual's country.

discovered_fields.name: single_act_evidence_sufficient
discovered_fields.description: Whether evidence of a single prohibited act is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, or conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: In any action, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

discovered_fields.name: firm_corrective_action_period_for_ownership_noncompliance
discovered_fields.description: Whether firms that fall out of compliance with ownership requirements due to changes in personnel are granted a reasonable period to take corrective action before facing permit suspension or revocation.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take such corrective action. Failure to bring the firm back into compliance within a reasonable period as defined by the board will result in the suspension or revocation of the firm permit.

discovered_fields.name: firm_permit_required_for_attest_services
discovered_fields.description: Whether a firm must hold a valid permit or registration to provide attest or compilation services, separate from individual licensure requirements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: No firm shall provide attest services or assume or use the title or designation 'certified public accountants' or the abbreviation 'CPAs' or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such firm is a CPA firm unless the firm holds a valid permit issued under this chapter.

discovered_fields.name: registered_municipal_accountant_designation
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state has a specialized 'Registered Municipal Accountant' designation requiring additional examination, limited to auditing municipal or county financial statements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A certified public accountant or public accountant holding an active license shall qualify as a registered municipal accountant by passing a registered municipal accountant's examination. Only a registered municipal accountant licensed in this State shall undertake the work of auditing the financial statements of any municipality or county.

discovered_fields.name: public_school_accountant_designation
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state has a specialized 'Public School Accountant' designation required for auditing school district financial statements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Any person who undertakes the work of auditing the financial statements of any school district in New Jersey shall qualify as a public school accountant (PSA) by submitting an application to the board, demonstrating satisfactorily to the board that the individual holds an active license in New Jersey as a certified public accountant, public accountant, or registered municipal accountant, and paying the required fee.

discovered_fields.name: accounting_practitioner_tier
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state has a separate 'Accounting Practitioner' or 'Licensed Public Accountant' tier below CPA with its own examination, education, and scope-of-practice requirements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: "Accounting practitioner" means a person certified under IC 25-2.1-6. An individual registered as an accounting practitioner may not prepare or render accounting opinions or certificates for any purpose, including financial statements, schedules, reports, or exhibits for publication, credit purposes, and use in a court.

discovered_fields.name: cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state provides a formal 'CPA Emeritus' or 'CPA Retired' status for licensees who have permanently ceased practice, with reduced or no fees and no CPE requirement.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A person currently licensed as a certified public accountant may, on any renewal date of that license, apply for and obtain a transfer of that license to a status of CPA emeritus registration if the licensee is at least 60 years of age as of the date of renewal, has a disability, or the board finds other good cause for believing that the licensee will not return to the practice of public accountancy.

discovered_fields.name: government_audit_cpe_requirement
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state imposes additional or specific continuing professional education requirements for CPAs engaged in auditing governmental entities.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: The board shall adopt rules establishing the continuing education requirements for Florida certified public accountants who are engaged in the audit of a governmental entity. The board shall approve subjects directly related to the governmental environment and to governmental auditing for purposes of satisfying the requirement of this subsection.

discovered_fields.name: ethics_cpe_hours_required
discovered_fields.description: Minimum hours of ethics-related continuing professional education required per renewal period.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: Not less than 5 percent of the total hours required by the board shall be in ethics applicable to the practice of public accounting. This requirement shall be administered by providers approved by the board, and a majority of the hours shall include a review of the provisions of chapter 455 and this chapter and the related administrative rules.

discovered_fields.name: hawaii_attest_work_supplement_required
discovered_fields.description: Whether Hawaii requires a state-specific supplemental peer review report covering Hawaii attest engagements when the primary peer review does not include Hawaii offices or engagements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A firm required to undergo a peer review under this chapter shall engage the services of a practitioner or firm holding a permit issued under section 466-7 to perform the following procedures to supplement the peer review report: Obtain from the reviewed firm a list of Hawaii attest engagements included in the scope of the peer review.

discovered_fields.name: liability_privity_limitation
discovered_fields.description: Whether the state limits CPA liability to third parties not in privity of contract, with exceptions for fraud, intentional misrepresentation, or known intended reliance.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A licensee, a CPA firm registered under this chapter, and any employee, partner, member, officer, or shareholder of a licensee or CPA firm are not liable to persons with whom they are not in privity of contract for civil damages resulting from acts, omissions, decisions, or other conduct in connection with professional services performed by that person, except for acts, omissions, decisions, or conduct that constitute fraud or intentional misrepresentations.

discovered_fields.name: statute_of_limitations_for_accountant_negligence
discovered_fields.description: Specific statute of limitations period for actions based on negligence or breach of contract against accountants, typically shorter than general tort limitations.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: An action covered by this section may not be brought in any court in this state unless the suit is commenced on or before the earlier of: (a) Two years from the date the alleged act, omission, or neglect is discovered or should have been discovered by the exercise of reasonable diligence; or (b) Six years after the service for which the suit is brought has been performed.

discovered_fields.name: independence_requirement_for_attest
discovered_fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly requires a CPA to be independent with respect to an enterprise before expressing an opinion on its financial statements.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A certified public accountant shall not express an opinion on the financial statements of an enterprise unless she or he and her or his firm are independent with respect to such enterprise.

discovered_fields.name: client_records_return_obligation
discovered_fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly requires a licensee to return client-provided records and furnish copies of working papers that constitute part of the client's records upon client request.
discovered_fields.sample_quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (1) A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that such working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and (2) Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client that the licensee removed from the client's premises or received for the client's account.

rows.issuing_authority: Alabama State Board of Public Accountancy
rows.education_degree: 150 semester hours including a baccalaureate degree

license_required.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accounting in this state shall be issued by the board to a holder of a certificate of certified public accountant issued under Section 34-1-4

issuing_authority.value: Alabama State Board of Public Accountancy
issuing_authority.quote: BOARD. The Alabama State Board of Public Accountancy created by Section 34-1-3

age_minimum.quote: Who has attained the age of 19 years.

moral_character_required.quote: Who is of good moral character.

degree_required.value: 150 semester hours including a baccalaureate degree
degree_required.quote: any person who has not previously sat for the uniform CPA examination shall have completed a total of 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours of postsecondary education, including a baccalaureate degree at a college or university accredited by a regional accreditation board

accrediting_body.value: Southern Association of Colleges and Universities (regional accreditation board)
accrediting_body.quote: a college or university accredited by a regional accreditation board such as the Southern Association of Colleges and Universities

required.quote: The experience requirement shall be one year of experience in the practice of public accounting as defined by the board's rules and regulations.

duration.quote: The experience requirement shall be one year of experience in the practice of public accounting

kind.value: experience in the practice of public accounting
kind.quote: one year of experience in the practice of public accounting as defined by the board's rules and regulations

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Administered by the board or its designee; covers accounting, auditing, business law, taxation, and other related subjects
exams.quote: Who has successfully passed a uniform examination, administered by the board or its designee, in accounting and auditing and in any other related subjects as the board deems necessary, including, but not limited to, business law and taxation

interval_years.quote: All permits shall expire on September 30 of each year and may be renewed annually for a period of one year.

required.quote: Every application for renewal of an annual permit to practice by any person who holds a certificate as a certified public accountant or who is a registrant under Section 34-1-8 shall be accompanied or supported by any evidence the board prescribes of satisfaction of its continuing education requirements during the preceding year.

available.quote: The board may waive the examination under subdivision (a)(5), and may issue a certificate as a certified public accountant to any person paying the application fee provided in subsection (c) who possesses the qualifications specified in subdivisions (a)(1) through (a)(3), and what the board determines to be substantially the equivalent of the applicable qualifications under subdivision (a)(4), and who is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant, then in full force and effect, issued under the laws of any state.

requirements.value: Must possess substantially equivalent qualifications and hold a valid CPA certificate from another state; CPAs transferring into Alabama must obtain an Alabama reciprocal certificate within 24 months from the date of transfer.
requirements.quote: Certified public accountants (CPAs) from other jurisdictions transferring into Alabama shall be required to obtain an Alabama reciprocal certificate within 24 months from the date of transfer.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless the person has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under Section 34-1-4 and if in public practice, holds a permit issued under Section 34-1-11

title_protection.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless the person has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under Section 34-1-4

scope_protection.quote: Only licensees holding a valid permit to practice or practicing pursuant to Section 34-1-7 may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render any attest service, as defined herein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a CPA certificate, registration, or permit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant, registration under this chapter, or a permit to practice public accounting under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of Section 34-1-16 (Acts Declared Unlawful)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of Section 34-1-16.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud under state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a CPA or PA by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant by any other state for any cause other than failure to pay an annual registration fee in the other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to be legally present in the state or become a US citizen within six years for non-citizens
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to be legally present in this state or to become a citizen of the United States within six years by any person not a citizen of the United States when he or she received a certificate as a certified public accountant or was registered as a public accountant under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to apply for an annual permit to practice or to be placed on the board's inactive roll within specified time periods
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to apply for an annual permit to practice or to be placed on the board's inactive roll within any of the following time periods

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the public accounting profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the public accounting profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish evidence of satisfaction of continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a certificate holder or registrant to furnish evidence of satisfaction of requirements of continuing education as required by the board pursuant to Section 34-1-11

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions and requirements of the board's peer review program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions and requirements of the board's peer review program.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with this chapter, board rules, or professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with this chapter or rules promulgated by the board under this chapter or failure to comply with professional standards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of another's application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a certificate, registration, or permit filed by another.

definition_quote.value: Providing the following services: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB).
definition_quote.quote: ATTEST. Providing the following services: a. Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS). b. Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS). c. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE). d. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB).

value: attest services
compilation services
preparation of financial statements
tax return preparation
management advisory services
other services involving the use of accounting skills
methods_authorized.quote: This restriction does not prohibit any act of a public official or public employee in the performance of that person's duties as such; or prohibit the performance by any person of other services involving the use of accounting skills, including the preparation of tax returns, management advisory services, and the preparation of financial statements without the issuance of reports thereon.

value: audit or other engagement under SAS
review of financial statement under SSARS
engagement under SSAE
engagement under PCAOB auditing standards
attest_services_types.quote: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS). b. Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS). c. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE). d. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB).

compilation_services_authorized.quote: COMPILATION. Providing a service of any compilation engagement to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS).

education_semester_hours_required.quote: any person who has not previously sat for the uniform CPA examination shall have completed a total of 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours of postsecondary education, including a baccalaureate degree

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: in order to be eligible for an initial sitting for the uniform CPA examination, a person shall have completed a total of 120 semester hours or 180 quarter hours of education, including a baccalaureate degree

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: a person who is licensed as a certified public accountant in another state whose principal place of business is not in this state shall have all the privileges of a certified public accountant in this state without the need to obtain a certificate or permit under this chapter or to notify or register with the board and may offer or render professional services in this state, whether in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, without any notice, fee, or other submission under this chapter.

value: personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of Alabama
compliance with this chapter and any rules promulgated by the board
cessation of offering or rendering professional services if the license from the home state is no longer valid
appointment of the out-of-state board as agent for service of process in any action by the Alabama board
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A person exercising the practice privilege granted in subsection (a) and any firm that employs the person, as a condition of the grant of the privilege, are deemed to consent to all of the following: (1) The personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of Alabama. education_semester_hours_required.quote: After January 1, 2000, at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board.

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: An applicant may apply to take the examination if such person, at the time of the examination, has completed not less than one hundred twenty semester hours of education

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: no notice, fee or other submission shall be required of any such individual

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board

Cease offering or rendering professional services if license from state of principal place of business is no longer valid

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the firm that employs such licensee shall consent, as a condition of the grant of such privilege: (1) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (2) To comply with any applicable provision of state law and the board's rules; (3) That in the event the license from the state of such individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, such individual shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of a firm; and (4) To the appointment of the state board that issued such license as the agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Any individual who qualifies for practice privileges under this section who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs any of the following services... may only provide such services through a firm that has obtained a permit issued under section 20-281e.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of the financial interests and voting rights of all proprietors, partners, members or shareholders of such firm, belongs to individuals holding a valid license to practice public accountancy issued by the licensing authority of a state or territory of the United States

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: No firm that is owned by one or more proprietors, partners, members or shareholders who do not hold a valid license to practice public accountancy issued by the licensing authority of a state or territory of the United States shall be granted an initial or renewed permit to practice under this section unless each such proprietor, partner, member or shareholder is (A) a natural person who actively participates in the business of the firm or its affiliated entities

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The State Board of Accountancy shall require, by regulation, that on and after January 1, 1990, as a condition to renewal of a permit to practice issued under section 20-281e that permit holders undergo a quality review

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Such a review shall be required every three years, except as provided in subsection (c) of this section.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Such letter shall not be a public record unless it is made part of the record of a disciplinary hearing.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this state may perform services described in subparagraph (B) of subdivision (13) of section 20-279b or subdivision (14) of section 20-279b for a client having its home office in this state and may use the title "Certified Public Accountant", "CPA", "CPA firm" or other similar title without a permit issued under this section

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a permit to practice under this section shall be required to register each office of the firm within this state with the board and to show that all attest services and compilation services rendered in this state are under the charge of a person holding a valid license issued under section 20-281b, 20-281d or by some other state.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee or any partner, officer, shareholder or employee of a licensee shall not voluntarily disclose information communicated to him by the client relating to and in connection with services rendered to the client by the licensee in the practice of public accountancy. Such information shall be deemed confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee or partner, shareholder, officer, director or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy... shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement to the contrary between the licensee and the client.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not recommend or refer any product or service to a client for a commission and shall not accept a commission from a client during the period that the licensee is performing for such client any of the following services... (1) An audit or review of a financial statement; (2) a compilation of a financial statement

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not, during any period in which the licensee is engaged to perform any of the services listed in this subsection... (1) Perform for a contingent fee any of the following professional services... (A) An audit or review of a financial statement; (B) a compilation of a financial statement... or (2) prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for any client.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: None of the foregoing provisions of this section shall apply to any firm holding a certification, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder thereof to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in such country, whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which he holds such entitlement, who issues no reports with respect to the financial statements of any other persons, firms or governmental units in this state, and who does not use in this state any title or designation other than the one under which he practices in such country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by sections 20-279b to 20-281m, inclusive, shall be sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order or conviction, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: No licensee or individual granted privileges under section 54-227, Idaho Code, shall perform attest services through any form of business that is not registered under the provisions of section 54-214, Idaho Code, or an equivalent provision of the laws of another state.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the beneficial ownership of the firm belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although a firm may include nonlicensee owners the firm and its ownership must comply with rules promulgated by the board.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Any licensee who issues compilation reports for the public other than through a firm must undergo no more frequently than once every three (3) years, a peer review conducted in accordance with rules prescribed by the board

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any licensee in current compliance with the provisions of this chapter who chooses not to perform or offer to perform for the public one (1) or more kinds of attest or compilation services may apply to place his or her license in inactive status.

retired_license_status_available.quote: After a person reaches the age of fifty-five (55) years, or in the event of a disability preventing continued practice, the certificate of a certified public accountant or licensed public accountant, upon application to the board by the holder, may be placed by the board in retired status.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Firms registered to practice under this section shall be required to register each office of the firm within this state with the board and to show that all attest and compilation reports rendered in this state are under the charge of a person holding a valid certificate and license issued by this state or some other state.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any licensee who is responsible for supervising attest services or compilation reports or who signs or authorizes someone to sign a report on financial statements on behalf of the firm, shall meet the competency requirements of the professional standards for such services.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not for a commission recommend or refer to a client any product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer any product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee or the licensee's firm also performs for that client: (i) An attest service

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not perform for a contingent fee any professional service for, or receive such a fee from, a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (i) An attest service

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The prohibitions of section 54-221, Idaho Code, and the other provisions of this chapter shall not be construed to preclude the use of the following language by any person: "I (We) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended."

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board shall issue a certificate and license to a holder of a substantially equivalent designation issued by a foreign country, provided that: (a) The foreign authority which granted the designation makes similar provision to allow a person who holds a valid certificate and license issued by this state to obtain such foreign authority's comparable designation

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited in this chapter shall be sufficient to justify a suspension, revocation, fine, administrative penalty, restriction, reprimand, injunction, restraining order, conviction or any other remedy authorized in this chapter. Evidence of a general course of conduct shall not be required.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after registration, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take such corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm must be registered with the board in order to provide attest services or compilation reports or in order to use the titles "CPAs," "CPA firm," "LPAs" or "LPA firm."

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any certified public accountant receiving the exemption from continuing professional education requirements must place the word "inactive" adjacent to his or her "CPA" title on any business card, telephone directory listing, letterhead or any other similar document or device

retired_license_status_available.quote: a certified public accountant receiving the exemption from continuing professional education requirements who has completely discontinued his or her performance of professional services, who has no active management or supervisory responsibilities in a firm, and who is at least sixty-two years of age is not required to place the word "inactive" or any other word adjacent to his or her "CPA" title

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this state may perform services described in subdivision (B), subsection (3), section two of this article, or subsection (12), section two of this article, for a client having its home office in this state and may use the title "CPA" or "CPA firm" without a permit issued under this section only if it meets firm ownership requirements and is undergoing a peer review program

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any certified public accountant, public accountant or substantial equivalency practitioner who signs or authorizes someone to sign an attest or compilation report on behalf of the permit holder meets the competency requirements set forth in the professional standards for those services specified by rule

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Any statement, record, schedule, working paper, and memorandum made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, member, manager or employee of a licensee incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client while a licensee, remains the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: No licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner or firm may, for a commission or referral fee, recommend or refer to a client any product or service or refer any product or service to be supplied by a client, or perform for a contingent fee any professional services for or receive a referral fee, commission or contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee, the substantial equivalency practitioner or firm works or associates or in which either of them owns an interest or who performs for that client: (A) An audit or review of a financial statement

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: No licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner may for a contingent fee prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund or serve as an expert witness.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The prohibitions of this section and the other provisions of this article may not be construed to preclude a person or business entity not holding a certificate or registration from using the following or substantially similar language: "I (We) have compiled the accompanying (financial statements)..."

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this article is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: The board shall suspend or revoke the permit of any firm that ceases to meet firm ownership requirements due to changes in firm ownership or personnel due to the death or retirement of a partner, officer, shareholder, member or manager and that fails to take corrective action in the manner and during the time period specified by rule.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing attest or compilation services

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means a person holding a registration who is not a certified public accountant.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: a licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request made within a reasonable time after original issuance of the document in question: (1) A copy of the tax return of the client; (2) A copy of any report or other document issued by the licensee to or for the client

accrediting_body.quote: baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

duration.quote: Completed at least one (1) year of full-time experience in the practice of public accounting.

kind.value: experience in the practice of public accounting
kind.quote: The experience shall include providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting skills, any auditing, review, or compilation service, any management advisory or financial advisory service, or any tax or consulting service.

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Written examination in accounting and auditing and other related subjects; board may use the uniform CPA examination and advisory grading service
exams.quote: The board may make use of any part of the uniform certified public accountant examination and advisory grading service as the board deems appropriate

interval_years.quote: All certificates shall expire on the last day of December of each year and may be renewed annually for a period of one (1) year

required.quote: Applications for renewal of an active certificate shall be accompanied by evidence of satisfaction of the continuing education requirements during the three (3) years preceding the application.

hours_per_period.quote: not exceeding one hundred twenty (120) hours for each three (3) year period

period_years.quote: not exceeding one hundred twenty (120) hours for each three (3) year period

available.quote: An individual whose principal place of business is not in this state and who holds a valid license as a certified public accountant from any state which the board...has determined to be in substantial equivalence...shall be presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to this state's requirements

requirements.value: Substantial equivalency: 150 semester hours, passing the uniform CPA exam, and 1 year of experience; or individual verification of substantial equivalency by the board
requirements.quote: An individual shall be deemed to meet the substantial equivalency requirements of this state if he meets the requirements of paragraph (i) or (ii) of this subsection

regulatory_model.quote: no person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA"...unless the person has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under the provisions of this act or has a practice privilege under W.S. 33-3-116(a).

title_protection.quote: no person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant unless the person has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under the provisions of this act or has a practice privilege under W.S. 33-3-116(a).

scope_protection.quote: This act applies only to certified public accountants and certified public accountant firms and those who hold themselves out to be a certified public accountant or a certified public accountant firm.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a CPA certificate or firm permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as certified public accountant or in obtaining a permit under this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting or in filing own income tax return
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence by a certificate holder or individual granted practice privileges: (A) In the practice of public accounting; or (B) In the filing or failure to file the holder's or the individual's own income tax return.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the CPA Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony related to the practice of accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony that relates to the practice of accounting or to the ability to practice accounting under the laws of Wyoming or any other state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of Wyoming or any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew CPA authority in another state for cause other than fee nonpayment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew the authority to practice as a certified public accountant by any other state for any cause other than failure to pay a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permanent revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permanent revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish evidence of satisfaction of continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a certificate holder to furnish evidence showing the satisfaction of the requirements of continuing education required by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to show compliance with practice monitoring program requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a certificate or permit holder to show compliance with W.S. 33-3-132 regarding practice monitoring programs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement in support of another's license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or privilege
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or privilege issued under this act or prior version of this act.

definition_quote.value: "the practice of certified public accounting" means holding oneself out to the public or otherwise in such a manner as to state or imply that one is: (i) Skilled in the practice of accounting and auditing; (ii) Qualified to express any form of assurance on financial statements; (iii) Qualified to express opinions on financial statements for credit purposes, for use in the courts or for other purposes involving third party reliance on these financial statements; or (iv) Skilled in the provision of any accounting service including recording and summarizing financial transactions, analyzing and verifying financial information, reporting financial results to an employer, clients or other parties and rendering tax or management advisory services to any employer, clients or other parties.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: any report, statement, memorandum, transcript, finding, record or working paper prepared and any opinion formulated in connection with any practice monitoring program...shall be considered privileged and shall not be subject to discovery, subpoena or other means of legal compulsion for release to any person or entity or be admissible as evidence in any judicial or administrative proceeding.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Persons holding a certificate issued under W.S. 33-3-109 or 33-3-116 but who do not practice public accounting in Wyoming and have not lost the right to active status may place the certificate on an inactive status.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual certificate holder or individual with practice privileges who is responsible for supervising attestation services or compilation services or who signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountant's report on the financial statements shall meet the experience or competency requirements set forth in the professional standards for such services.

The board, through rule and regulation, shall specify a period of time for firms to take corrective action.
